note: Interpretive text for engine/doshas.py's 4 afflictions (Pitra, Guru Chandal, Grahan, Shrapit). items.title: Rahu or Ketu in the 9th House
items.summary: A shadow planet occupying the house of father, ancestors, and dharma.
items.effects: Rahu or Ketu placed in the 9th house (father, ancestors, dharma, fortune) is one of the most commonly cited Pitra Dosha indicators - read as the 9th house's ancestral significations being colored by that shadow planet's unsettled, karmic nature.

items.title: Sun Conjunct Rahu or Ketu
items.summary: The Sun (father, ancestors, authority) conjunct a shadow planet.
items.effects: The Sun classically signifies the father and paternal lineage; conjunct Rahu or Ketu, some traditions read this as the same ancestral-affliction theme as Pitra Dosha, independent of which house it happens in.

items.title: 9th Lord Afflicted
items.summary: The lord of the 9th house conjunct a natural malefic.
items.effects: The 9th house's own lord conjunct a natural malefic (Sun, Mars, Saturn, Rahu, or Ketu) is read as putting strain on the 9th house's own significations - fortune, father, dharma, and by extension the ancestral-blessing theme some traditions group under Pitra Dosha.

items.title: Guru Chandal Dosha
items.summary: Jupiter conjunct Rahu - wisdom and expansion colored by Rahu's amplifying nature.
items.effects: Jupiter (wisdom, teachers, ethics, expansion) conjunct Rahu (amplification, unconventional paths, obsession) is a specifically named classical combination - read as Jupiter's guru/wisdom significations becoming unconventional, restless, or prone to attachment to the wrong teacher or belief system. Some traditions also read a more positive face: unconventional or boundary-crossing wisdom, when Jupiter is otherwise well-placed.

items.title: Surya Grahan Dosha (Sun eclipsed)
items.summary: The Sun conjunct Rahu or Ketu - the solar-eclipse axis touching the birth chart.
items.effects: The Sun (self, vitality, father, authority) conjunct Rahu or Ketu is read as an 'eclipse' on the Sun's own significations - some dimming or complication of confidence, authority, or relationship with the father figure, alongside Rahu/Ketu's own karmic themes.

items.title: Chandra Grahan Dosha (Moon eclipsed)
items.summary: The Moon conjunct Rahu or Ketu - the lunar-eclipse axis touching the birth chart.
items.effects: The Moon (mind, emotions, mother) conjunct Rahu or Ketu is read as an 'eclipse' on the Moon's own significations - emotional restlessness, an unsettled or amplified inner life, alongside Rahu/Ketu's own karmic themes. Classically considered one of the more commonly discussed Grahan Dosha forms.

items.title: Shrapit Dosha (Shrapit Yog)
items.summary: Saturn conjunct Rahu - a 'cursed'/ancestral-pattern affliction with sudden reversals.
items.effects: Saturn (delay, restriction, karma) conjunct Rahu (amplification, obsession, unconventional paths) is a specifically named classical combination, sometimes called a 'curse' affliction - read as delays and restrictions that compound unpredictably, sudden reversals, and family-pattern themes repeating across generations.
